newsitem.title: UK: Young Europeans don't want EU to interfere - poll.
newsitem.headline: Young Europeans don't want EU to interfere - poll.

text.p: Young Europeans are nationalists who object to "a bunch of people sitting in Brussels deciding how my country is run," a poll showed on Thursday.
The survey, a snapshot taken in eight countries across the continent, painted a picture of right-wing traditionalists who favoured arming the police and castrating child molesters.
Among the 1,600 16-24 year-olds polled by the MTV pop music channel, France was picked as the best loved country and Germany as the least popular.

"It is very revealing that despite the gathering momentum, young people are a long way from wanting or believing in the possibility of a united Europe," MTV Networks Europe executive director Rachel Purnell said.

Nationalism was rife among young Europeans with 57 percent overall objecting to any more interference from the European Union in how their countries were run. The British and the Swedes emerged as the top Eurosceptics. Sixty percent of those polled believed that drugs such as marijuana had taken the place of alcohol in society. Marijuana led Ecstasy as Europe's most popular drug with the British and French most eager to experiment.
Half of those polled by MTV in Britain, Germany, The Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, Spain, France and Italy smoked more than 20 cigarettes a day.

The young feared rising crime and wanted armed police to combat it. Almost half backed capital punishment. Seventy-eight percent said child molesters should be castrated. One in four would sell a body organ if desperate for money.

"What really startled us about the findings is that even though there are pockets of rebellion and a veneer of liberalism, many young Europeans can be conservative in a way you might not expect," MTV's Purnell said. Europeans do not on average lose their virginity until they are almost 17. But Britons are the exception, starting at 15 years and seven months. That is a year before the average German and almost two and a half years before Italians.
Asked where they most enjoyed sex away from home, the French opted for the beach, Spaniards picked a nightlcub and Swedes preferred public toilets.
